Place the Windows portable Tesseract distribution here before building an offline
Windows installer:
  vendor/tesseract/tesseract.exe
  vendor/tesseract/tessdata/vie.traineddata
  vendor/tesseract/tessdata/eng.traineddata
  plus all required Tesseract DLL files from the same distribution.
No binaries or model files are redistributed in this source archive.
For Windows use a distribution with licensing and integrity checks approved by
your organization, and test the bundled EXE on a clean disconnected machine.
